text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's New Year's Day, and I've arranged
for Aston
Machan to have a day off from
all the hard work
she's been putting in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just when I decide to update the
four-panel
comic blog...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Are you busy today?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about we take a little
walk? I
have somewhere in mind.
choice_data_list: これといった予定はないよ

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The track.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I was doing some solo training since I
have the
day off, but...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I thought it'd be better if I had someone
there to
watch me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Then they could take my time for me
and assess
my form. Would you mind
doing that?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho isn't far off. There's really
no time to
rest.
choice_data_list: いや、俺は君に休んでほしくて……
いや、私は貴方に休んでほしくて……

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I want to get big and strong this winter,
so I'm not
planning on taking any breaks
from my training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She hands me a notebook chock full of
training
plans.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Eheh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although I was hoping she'd get some
rest... I
doubt she'd pay my protests any
mind, so I
decide to help her out.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Okay, next up is...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hm... The New Year Special Circuit.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but what should we do? We've only
got time
for one of these activities.
choice_data_list: （……お正月スペシャルシリーズ？）

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: All right. I'll leave it up to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We could do a giant kite dash, go and
pray at the
shrine, or play a game of
Machan karuta.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The one that jumps out at me is...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Good choice. I'm glad I brought my giant
kite just
in case.
choice_data_list: 巨大たこ揚げダッシュ

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll get everything ready. Please
wait a
moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Moments later, she reappears—along
with a
gigantic kite that must be at least
four meters
wide!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The string around my waist is
custom-made. It's
extra thick so it
doesn't rip the moment I start
running.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes—the idea is to train by running with
a kite
attached to my waist.
choice_data_list: たこ揚げダッシュって、もしかして……

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The weather is lovely today, so I'm sure
it'll fly
beautifully.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Who knows, perhaps it'll even lift me
along with
it. I was thinking it might be
nice to take flight for
a few moments.
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a faint hope of flight in our hearts,
we begin
training. However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Frrrp... Frrrp...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Aw. It's flying too low. I must not be
running fast
enough...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I need to run even faster—like a strong
gust of
wind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before we know it, our New Year's Day
comes to
an end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to spending another year
working
hard alongside Aston Machan!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hm, prayers it is. Interesting.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's head to the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...There sure are a lot of people here.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right. It is New Year's Day,
after all.
choice_data_list: みんな、初詣をしに来ているから

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So, will you be praying too, Trainer? Or
have you
already prayed?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, before long, we find ourselves
praying
side by side...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...
...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: What did you pray for?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I prayed earnestly for her
health and
success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before we know it, our New Year's Day
comes to
an end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to spending another year
working
hard alongside Aston Machan!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's a good choice. Let's play
Machan
karuta!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It's the Machan version of the traditional card game, the Umamusume Hundred Poets.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After she gives me a brief explanation,
we go to
the gym, and she hands me
some reading cards.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm ready to run now, so please read out
one of
those cards at random.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The standard rules are just like Umamusume Hundred Poets. It's played in teams of two—one person gives the instructions, while the other runs to take cards.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But since you and I are the only ones
playing,
we'll use special rules this time.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In our version, you'll read the first half of
a poem,
and then I'll go collect the card
with the latter
half on it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems excited, so I decide to go
along with it
and ask questions later.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I shuffle the cards, recite the
introductory poem,
and then read out
the phrase on the first card.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That's a Machan card. You're pretty
lucky,
Trainer.
choice_data_list: 『マーちゃんよ　走れよ走れ』……？

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The whole passage is, "Run, Machan,
run, with
grace and ease"...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ..."A lovely sprint as swift as the breeze."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Okay, I got the card!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before we know it, our New Year's Day
comes to
an end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to spending another year
working
hard alongside Aston Machan!
